steps.name: Implement
steps.prompt: Implement {key} ({url}) in worktree group {worktree}. Then run {done} --verdict done --note "<one line>".

steps.name: Review Implementation
steps.prompt: Check the work in {worktree} against {key}. Then run {done} --verdict pass or {done} --verdict gaps, with --note.

steps.name: Implement Fixes
steps.prompt: Fix each gap of the last review comment on {key}. Then run {done} --verdict done.
